title: Climate-Smart Agri-Energy: Opportunities for Uganda's NDC Implementation
summary: Brief exploring how agri-energy investments can contribute to Uganda's Nationally Determined Contribution commitments and support climate adaptation in the agriculture sector.
description: Uganda's Nationally Determined Contribution (NDC) under the Paris Agreement includes agricultural and energy sector targets. This policy brief explores the intersection of agri-energy and NDC implementation, identifying how solar pumping, biogas, improved biomass, and agro-processing clean energy can be counted as both adaptation and mitigation actions. The brief provides a framework for integrating agri-energy into Uganda's National Adaptation Plans, examines climate finance opportunities (GCF, AF, LDCF) accessible to the agri-energy sector, and presents a series of concrete policy recommendations. It is aimed at planners in the Ministry of Water and Environment, MAAIF, NREP, and the Uganda NDC coordination office.
